svg.title: Thirty Days to a Decision-Ready Acquisition Search
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days-search-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to a Decision-Ready Acquisition Search; subtitle: Build an evidence pipeline without pretending the first deal closes in a month.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: This is a pre-acquisition launch sprint. First-deal timing remains 6–18 months; the 100-day turnaround starts after closing. Numeric values are milestone endpoint days.; caption: Complete one inspectable operating artifact each week. A missing seller document becomes a tracked diligence issue, not an invented input to the debt model.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Deliver the buy box and capital plan; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Assign the acquisition lead; document sector exclusions, buyer liquidity, operator capacity, and concentration limits. Build the four-bucket capital worksheet and identify lender and specialist interview targets.; label: Days 8-14; value: Deliver the tracked sourcing cohort; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure Airtable stages and deduplication; begin broker and owner outreach. Record response evidence, confidentiality terms, seller authority, and requested records without treating the illustrative funnel as a quota.; label: Days 15-21; value: Deliver the first evidence-backed screening memo; numeric value: 21.0; detail: For a responsive target, reconcile available statements to deposits, review customer concentration, and build an interest-and-principal schedule. If records are insufficient, issue a precise evidence request instead.; label: Days 22-30; value: Deliver the pursue, revise, or reject decision; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Review the four pre-flight checks, document downside liquidity, and price unresolved liabilities. Prepare LOI terms only for a supported candidate; otherwise revise the search and preserve diligence capital.

text.title: Thirty Days to a Decision-Ready Acquisition Search
text.tspan: Thirty Days to a Decision-Ready Acquisition Search

rect.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Deliver the buy box and capital plan; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Assign the acquisition lead; document sector exclusions, buyer liquidity, operator capacity, and concentration limits. Build the four-bucket capital worksheet and identify lender and specialist interview targets.

text.title: Deliver the buy box and capital plan
text.tspan: Deliver the buy box and capital plan

rect.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Deliver the tracked sourcing cohort; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure Airtable stages and deduplication; begin broker and owner outreach. Record response evidence, confidentiality terms, seller authority, and requested records without treating the illustrative funnel as a quota.

label: Days 15-21; value: Deliver the first evidence-backed screening memo; numeric value: 21.0; detail: For a responsive target, reconcile available statements to deposits, review customer concentration, and build an interest-and-principal schedule. If records are insufficient, issue a precise evidence request instead.

text.title: Deliver the first evidence-backed screening memo

rect.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Deliver the pursue, revise, or reject decision; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Review the four pre-flight checks, document downside liquidity, and price unresolved liabilities. Prepare LOI terms only for a supported candidate; otherwise revise the search and preserve diligence capital.
